changes: Remove the cascade, its seven rock supports, landing rings, splash droplets and mist.

Replace the stationary rear quad with a distant spherical sky environment. Recompute the soft angular aperture from the camera-to-forest direction and projected arena size each frame. Sky remains behind the forest when viewing from another side.

Keep clouds world-oriented while the sphere follows camera translation. Head rotation naturally changes the visible part of the environment. Preserve transparent coverage outside the forest aperture and the four-second bottom-to-top reveal.

Rework the creek with travelling filtered wave normals, deeper centre/shallow-bank colours, view-dependent sky reflection, soft highlights and subtle caustics. Remove the authored static white foam bars; keep seven sparse moving foam wisps.
Retain 40 warm dust motes and three delicate wind ribbons, with arena-local positioning and pause-aware animation.

xr_contract.background: Distant inward-facing sphere; no fixed scenery quad. Soft aperture centred on the forest direction, independent of head yaw. Looking away from the subject leaves empty regions transparent.
xr_contract.alpha: Transparent camera clear; sky clips outside its angular coverage; separate RGB/alpha blending preserves compositor coverage.
xr_contract.stereo: Shaders retain Unity instanced stereo macros and use per-eye world view direction. Worn-headset stereo/compositor acceptance is still pending.
xr_contract.platforms: Existing Quest underlay and PICO passthrough settings retained. No SDK or input changes.

interaction_contract: Presentation only. No changes to grabbing, trigger thresholds, refill amounts, fire damage or interaction colliders.

checks: Rendered sky behind the forest at orbit angles -80, 0 and 80 degrees with head yaw -25, 0 and 25 degrees, plus a rear orbit at 180 degrees
Empty side/rear/up/down view alpha remains zero
Bottom-to-top reveal, pause/recenter, foreground visibility and camera restoration
No cascade child objects; bounded reused effects mesh
Actual rendered creek colour and frame-to-frame motion
verification.capture_scope: Actual Unity scene with live frame advancement, scripted camera orbit followed by a head-yaw sweep. HUD/interaction guides hidden for art review. Black areas in the MP4/GIF represent transparent background; PNG captures retain alpha. Desktop render, not headset footage or performance measurement.
verification.settings: Test runner restored Editor scene list, scene setup and background execution settings.

delivery: Included in Quest 0.2.19, with background supersession as noted. Installed version verified. No PICO build.
remaining_acceptance: Quest/PICO worn-headset stereo and passthrough edge appearance
Device GPU/frame timing under fire and effects load
historical_scope: The circular angular background mask, source hashes and captures describe the prior source iteration. River, waterfall removal and ambient effects remain current; the fitted background is defined by SubjectFittedBackdrop.json.
superseded_in: 0.2.20; see InteractionUsabilityAndSky.json. Original release evidence retained.
